global_caption: The video consists of 8 shots and is styled as a high-saturation anime advertisement. The setting is a neon-drenched city after rain, dominated by cool blue-purple neon tones accented with golden metallic highlights. Lighting is unified through wet surface reflections and neon edge glows. The camera movement is sharp and fast-paced, punctuated by brief pauses for product display. There is no The emotional tone remains consistently cold and oppressive, yet subtly hints at awakening.
shot1: Shot 1 fades in from black, using a wide overhead perspective. Composition arranges skyscrapers to converge toward the center of the frame. Foreground features water-dripping rooftop edges; background shows neon-lit blocks softened by rain mist. Wet city pavement reflects large areas of blue-purple and magenta light. A golden divine dragon speeds through the buildings, its scales shimmering like metal clockwork under neon, trailing fine rain droplets and air turbulence. Camera performs high-speed lateral tracking followed by slight downward tilt. Wind
shot2: Shot 2 connects with the previous shot via hard cut, using a dynamic dive from wide to close-up perspective. The camera plunges from above the dragon’s back down to its outstretched claw, which holds a mechanical watch. The watch case edges echo the dragon’s scale patterns. Composition centers on the watch, while background buildings and billboards blur into streaked lines due to speed. Rain threads slice diagonally across the foreground, enhancing depth. Camera rapidly pushes forward then slightly orbits, causing the watch to rotate slowly in midair. Sharp highlights appear on lugs and bezel. Wind tightens, rain tapping metal becomes more distinct, and street echoes intensify.
shot3: Shot 3 transitions from previous shot via match cut into macro close-up. Eye-level ultra-close perspective with shallow depth of field. Foreground is blurred vapor and metal edge, focus lands on internal gear meshing. Fine gears, escapement, and mainspring wheel alternate flashing blue-purple and gold reflections under neon. Humidity is conveyed via tiny water beads on metal surfaces. Mechanical structure begins operating—gears advance layer by layer, local speed gradually increases. Camera moves extremely slowly forward with subtle horizontal shift, bringing different component levels into clarity.
shot4: Shot 4 transitions from previous shot via dial highlight sweeping across screen into medium eye-level shot. Composition uses wet zebra crossing stripes as leading lines. Foreground shows rain-shattered puddles; focus is a sharp beam of light cast by the watch dial slicing across the street. The dial outline does not fully enter frame but appears as a large abstract reflection covering the intersection. The dragon’s silhouette flashes in the puddle reflection, creating a layered reality-fantasy ad effect. Nearby neon signs flicker gently. Street echoes stretch in the open intersection.
shot5: Shot 5 connects with previous shot via hard cut into dual close-up. Low-angle near-shot composition. Left foreground: one golden dragon eye; right background: watch second hand and partial markings, softly blurred. As camera slowly pushes in, the dragon’s pupil contracts in sync with the second hand. The eye interior reflects city signage like liquid metal. A cold edge glow sweeps across the watch crystal. Camera slowly pushes in to heighten tension.
shot6: Shot 6 connects with previous shot via energy-driven hard cut, entering a wide low-angle view. Scene shifts to corner billboard and building junction. Dragon coils atop the billboard frame, body entwined with LED scan lines. The watch is enlarged into a city-scale main visual floating at the center of the screen. The watch case edge refracts light suddenly, exploding into fragmented golden shards radiating outward fan-like. Surrounding glass facades and wet streets simultaneously catch this flash burst. Composition centers the billboard, vertical building lines enhance upward momentum. Camera rapidly ascends from below, then slightly tilts back, emphasizing product divinity and urban scale. Wind is sliced by the refractive explosion; raindrops seem momentarily sucked away halfway, then street echoes surge back.
shot7: Shot 7 transitions from previous shot via refracted fragment wipe into medium-close eye-level shot. Camera advances straight down the street. Multiple layers of sharp-typed text sweep across foreground, midground, and background. Dense subtitles, rendered in semi-transparent metallic strokes with neon outlines, press into the frame layer by layer. First text group “驭时而行” enters diagonally from top-left to bottom-right, trailing sharp tails and rain-dispersed flying white effects. Second group “机械心跳觉醒” follows vertically from bottom, overlapping streetlight boxes and dragon remnants. Typography slices through city air like blades. Watch outline flickers through text gaps. Camera maintains steady forward push with slight sway, as if moving through a storm of words. Wind and rain are rhythmically cut by text-screen penetration. Distant thunder drops a low-frequency hit exactly when the second text group fully settles.
shot8: Shot 8 concludes with fade-in to final product close-up. Close-up eye-level slightly low-angle composition. Centered is a mechanical watch suspended against a dark blue neon background. Case, bracelet, and crystal edges are sharply outlined in golden highlights. Background features an arcing dragon silhouette, retaining only outline and sparse scale glints, ensuring product remains absolute focus. Scattered raindrops in shallow depth of field become tiny light spots. After rotation stops, the watch freezes perfectly. The second hand finally ticks gently to the hour mark. Brand name “神话机芯，掌控分秒” appears in heavy metallic texture at the lower third of the frame, with cold neon glow and faint water-stain reflection. It emerges via forceful zoom-in from distance, then locks steadily. Camera completes final half-second extremely slow push-in. Wind fades, leaving only sparse raindrops and echoing emptiness suspended over the freeze-frame.
